verdict.rationale: An official Smithery CLI exists and is maintained under the acquirer's arcadeai-labs org (npm smithery@latest), with documented registry, tool and skills commands. However, the October 31, 2026 shutdown stopped the hosted connection services, accounts and API keys, and deprecated the service-tied CLI versions, so the continuing CLI works only against the public registry. Connection-dependent commands such as tool call are left on uncertain footing. Missing for 10: confirmation that connection and tool commands still work after the shutdown, first-party docs (the docs tree was removed), and independent hands-on corroboration of current CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.

The CLI itself continues under the acquirer's org (github.com/arcadeai-labs/smithery-cli, npm smithery@latest) against the public registry; the shutdown covers the hosted services and the service-tied versions.
The maintained CLI commands are the only documented discovery surface against the public registry.
